title: MI40036: Advanced Quantitative Decision Making
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Syllabus for QDM:

Linear programming: concepts, graphical solutions, simplex method, primal-dual
models, sensitivity analysis, transportation and assignment problems. Network
analysis - problems of shortest path, minimal spanning tree, maximal flow, CPM
and PERT. 

Syllabus for AQDM:

Dynamic programming and stagecoach problem; Discrete and continuous
probability distributions, stochastic process and Markov chains; Basic queuing
models with constant arrival and service rates; Inventory models.
